exposure: Combined intervention of Traditional Chinese medicine analgesic and delivery-aiding patches with doula-assisted childbirth
outcome: Duration of labor (first, second, and total)
cohort: The study included 240 puerperae from Haian Hospital of Traditional Chinese Medicine, divided into a control group receiving routine delivery and an observation group receiving combined traditional Chinese medicine analgesic patches and doula-assisted childbirth.
finding: The application of traditional Chinese medicine analgesics and delivery-aiding patches in doula-assisted childbirth significantly reduced the cesarean section rate, shortened labor durations, alleviated labor pain, and reduced postpartum hemorrhage compared to routine delivery.
mod_finding: The study found that the combined intervention of traditional Chinese medicine patches and doula-assisted childbirth significantly reduced the cesarean section rate.
